name: timezone-mismatch
title: Timezone Mismatch
description: Banner shown when the device zone differs from the account zone: both clocks side by side, a one-time choice to use the device zone, a confirmation that keeps focus, remembered per pair of zones, comparing real clock changes so briefly drifting zones still count.

meta.stops: Misread every time by hours while travelling
meta.summary: When the device's time zone differs from the account's, shows both clocks and asks once which to use, so times aren't misread while travelling.
catches: Device and account zones that differ now or at any clock change in the coming year
Zones that drift apart only for a few days (e.g. Jerusalem and Athens)
Unknown zones the runtime can't resolve
The user's choice, remembered per pair of zones
limits: Choice is stored in localStorage on this device
Device zone comes from the browser and can be wrong behind some VPNs or settings
a11y: Banner is a region with an aria-label; result is role=status and receives focus
Message in a polite live region
